properties.content:

Incident Time: 2007-02-02 18:00:00
Nearest City: Washington, DC
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: ANTIFREEZE
Medium Affected: LAND
Suspected Responsible Party: AUTO ZONE
Skytruth Analysis
CALLER IS REPORTING THAT HE SLIPPED AND FELL IN A LARGE PUDDLE OF MOTOR OIL IN THE AUTO ZONE PARKING LOT. THE FIRE DEPARTMENT ARRIVED ON-SCENE AND SENT THE INDIVIDUAL TO THE HOSPITAL FOR AN INJURY. A. WILLIAMS BADGE #3011, A FIREMAN WAS ONE OF THE EMERGENCY PERSONNEL ON-SCENE. THE MANAGEMENT FILLED OUT AN ACCIDENT REPORT. THERE ARE POT HOLES WITH ANTIFREEZE IN THEM AND LARGE PUDDLES OF OIL IN PARKING LOT. THERE IS ALSO A NEARBY STORM DRAIN THAT FEEDS INTO THE POTOMAC RIVER AND ANACOSTIA BAY. THE FIRE DEPARTMENT STATED THAT THEY WERE LIMITED ON ACTIONS AND COULD NOT ENFORCE THEM TO CLEAN UP.
